meaning: अति सावधान / सूक्ष्म विवरणों पर ध्यान देने वाला (Extreme care about minute details)
परिश्रमी / मेहनती (Hard-working and done with great care)
व्यावहारिक (Dealing with things sensibly and realistically)
परोपकारी / दयालु (Kind and helpful)
अल्पकालिक / क्षणभंगुर (Lasting for a very short time)
प्रचुर / भरपूर (Available in large quantities)
आपदा / कठिनाई (A difficult or unpleasant situation)
स्पष्टवादी / निष्कपट (Truthful and straightforward)
पहेली / रहस्यमय (A person or thing that is mysterious)
मितव्ययी / कम खर्च करने वाला (Simple and plain and costing little)
बातूनी (Excessively talkative)
अभिमानी / घमंडी (Arrogantly superior and disdainful)
अपरिहार्य / जो होकर रहेगा (Certain to happen; unavoidable)
प्रफुल्लित / बहुत खुश (Feeling or expressing great happiness)
सुस्त / आलसी (Affected by lethargy; sluggish)
कम करना / हल्का करना (Make something bad less severe)
पुरानी यादें (A sentimental longing for the past)
अस्पष्ट (Not discovered or known about; uncertain)
विचारमग्न (Engaged in deep or serious thought)
विचित्र पर आकर्षक (Attractively unusual or old-fashioned)
लचीला / फिर से उभरने वाला (Able to withstand or recover quickly from difficulties)
संदेही (Not easily convinced; having doubts)
तुच्छ / मामूली (Of little value or importance)
सर्वव्यापक (Present, appearing, or found everywhere)
सम्मान करना (Regard with great respect; revere)
सावधान / सतर्क (Feeling or showing caution)
उत्साह / जोश (Great energy or enthusiasm)
मिलनसार (Having or displaying a friendly and pleasant manner)
अशिष्ट / रूखा (Abrupt or offhand in speech or manner)
आत्मसंतुष्ट (Showing smug or uncritical satisfaction with oneself)
